review_policy: severe-artifact veto first, then visibly stylized film-inspired appeal
observations: The darker rich rendering is generally preferred to the cyan or pale high-key alternative on architecture, documents and low-light scenes.
The more chromatic blue-yellow snow and magenta-cloud variants are preferred where they add separation without washing out structure.
No candidate is rejected for severe face, text, object, geometry, banding, seam, clipping-block or repeated-texture failure at contact-sheet scale.
claim_ceiling: Autonomous blind visual evidence on development contact sheets; not population preference, full-resolution adjudication, stock response, calibration or product promotion.
